messages:
Alex K: PTAL — addressed the allocator comments from yesterday, reworked free-list rotation and added a unit test + smoke script. I updated the PR description with the before/after perf numbers. PTAL before I schedule a canary. leaning toward squash for this one. need one more infra confirmer.
Sara M: skimmed diff, looks good overall. small nit: can we rename `rot_idx` -> `rotIndex` for clarity? otherwise :thumbsup:.
Alex K: yep, makes sense. will push rename in a minute.
Sam P: ran the smoke locally (mac M1 -> linux container). command I used:
```bash
./scripts/smoke.sh --alloc 1000 --iterations 50
```
smoke passed for me, no new flakes. left a short note in the PR about memory transient at ~2k alloc.
Alex K: pushed the rename and updated the smoke instructions in the PR body. also added a small changelog entry under `unreleased/runtime`. PTAL @Sara M @Mohit R.
deploy-bot: CI checks started for PR #4876 — running unit tests, lint, and e2e.
deploy-bot: CI passed (all green).
Mohit R: quick look — runtime side LGTM, but infra should confirm capacity scheduling for canary.
ops-oncall: we have a free canary slot Tue 10:00-11:00 PT. I can monitor and collect traces. ping me when you request the slot.
Jean L: minor doc ask: could you add an upgrade note in docs/upgrade.md about the allocator behaviour change? otherwise fine.
Alex K: added the upgrade note and linked to the changelog line. requested the canary slot with ops. tagging @ops-oncall — please confirm monitoring and alert thresholds.
Sara M: LGTM after rename and docs.
Mohit R: approved.
ops-oncall: confirmed, I'll set up a short-runbook and watch the dashboards. If anything spikes, we'll pause. good to go from ops.
Alex K: great — thanks everyone. scheduling canary for Tue 10:00 PT. will post results in this thread after the run. :rocket:
